description:
Subject: New Angular Feature Module – User Management  

Hi Team,  

We need to add a **user‑management** module to the **my-angular-app** project. Please generate the module under the folder **src/app/features/user-management**, attaching it to the existing **AppModule**. The files should be created as a flat structure (no additional sub‑directory), and we don’t need to import the **CommonModule**. Since this feature requires its own routing, enable a routing module with a **Child** scope, but omit the accompanying spec file for now.  

Thanks for handling this setup. Let me know if any clarification is needed.
